title: Focus micro‑agenda — eng 1:1 prep (Ashlyn)
content:
Meeting: weekly 1:1 with report (30m)
Participant: Ashlyn (manager) + Priya Rao (IC3, inference infra)
Date/time: 2026-02-03 10:00am PT
Location: Zoom / async notes in this doc

Top objectives for this 1:1 (pick 2):
- unblock major work (dedicated autoscaler regressions) — aim to land hotfix this sprint
- short career check — calibrate expectations and top growth area for next 3 months

Quick status snapshot (to read quickly before meeting):
- Current focus: autoscaler bugfix + perf regression investigation on 80-token loads
- Oncall rotations: clear for next week
- PRs: 2 open (one small hotfix, one integration test flake)
- Mood: sounded slightly frustrated in last sync — cadence slipping due to infra churn

Agenda (30m) — compact micro‑timing
1) 0–5m: quick pulse — how are you feeling? (one sentence) + any urgent blockers
2) 5–12m: triage autoscaler bug — what blocked you this week? what do you need from me?
   - Ask: do you need cross-team support (release eng / infra ops)?
3) 12–18m: PR runway — which PRs need review / approvals? set target for merge
4) 18–24m: career checkpoint (biggest growth win + skill to practice)
   - Prompt: "What would success look like for you in 90 days?"
5) 24–28m: small wins / recognition + calendar planning for deep work slots
6) last 2m: summarize action items, confirm follow-ups, and set next micro-goal

Prep notes / facts to reference:
- Autoscaler regression: saw ~12% higher p95 on 80-token batches on 2/28 canary. Root cause likely changed kernel selection when cache hit rate dropped. (Link to perf dashboard: ENG dash ID 88)
- Priya owns the hotfix branch: "hotfix/autoscaler-small-batch". Build is failing on integration test 14 (flaky seed).
- Release window: aiming for canary 2/5 if tests pass.

Possible manager actions to offer (choose 1–2 to keep focused):
- Offer to pull in Release Eng for 30m pairing tomorrow morning to clear integration test flake
- Reprioritize other tasks off Priya's board for next 48h so she can focus on the hotfix
- Approve a short pairing budget for GPU time to reproduce the regression at scale

Career checkpoint prompts (short, conversational):
- "What's one bit of feedback you'd want me to give you now?"
- "What skill would you like structured practice on — e.g., cross-team influence, incident postmortems, or perf debugging?"
- Goal setting: discuss one measurable goal (example: reduce end-to-end autoscaler incident TTR from 6h to <3h by Q2)

Notes-to-self (manager):
- Keep the tone coaching-first; avoid tactical firefighting unless Priya explicitly asks (we want empowerment)
- If she asks for heads-down time, explicitly clear two half-days on her calendar
- Mention the possibility of a short shadowing pairing with Senior Release Eng (Marco) next week

Draft follow-up action items (to record during meeting) — capture as short TODOs with owners and dates:
- Priya: push hotfix branch and resolve flaky integration test (due 2026-02-04)
- Ashlyn: schedule 30m pairing with Release Eng (Marco) for 2026-02-03 morning (owner: Ashlyn)
- Priya + Ashlyn: define one 90-day growth goal and acceptance criteria (update doc by 2026-02-10)
- Ashlyn: clear low-priority tickets from Priya's board for next 48h (done by 2026-02-03 EOD)

Metrics snapshot to mention (quick bullets):
- p95 latency on 80-token batch: baseline 120ms -> canary 134ms (target <125ms)
- Autoscaler incident count last 30d: 3 (2 mitigated by fallback)
- PR review time (Priya): median 26h (goal <24h)

Questions I want answered in the 1:1:
- What specifically is blocking the flaky test? (env vs seed vs infra timing)
- Do you feel you have runway to land the hotfix this sprint? If not, what timeline is realistic?
- Do you want formal mentoring on postmortems or just ad‑hoc feedback?

Post‑meeting followup template (copy into Slack/email after meeting):
Hi Priya — good note-taking from our 1:1. Quick recap and owners: 
- Hotfix branch: Priya -> push & fix flaky test (due 2/4)
- Pairing with Release Eng: Ashlyn -> scheduled for 2/3 morning
- 90-day goal: Priya/Ashlyn -> define by 2/10
LMK if I missed anything. Thanks!

Loose ideas / experiments to bring up if time allows (low priority):
- Small chaos experiment: introduce synthetic cache misses on a small pool to reproduce kernel selection path
- Add a lightweight regression test that runs nightly in CI with 80-token microbench

Scratch — quick personal reminders:
- Don't over-schedule: keep empathy + curiosity up front
- Call out Priya's recent ownership of the quantization experiment (positive reinforcement)

End of doc.
summary: Compact 30m manager prep for weekly 1:1 with engineer (autoscaler hotfix + 90-day career check). Contains agenda with micro timings, facts, manager offers, action items, metrics snapshot, and post-meeting follow-up template.
